extracted.name: Three Bean Soup
extracted.description: This quick and easy three bean soup is made with a healthy trio of canned beans (black, pinto, and kidney), bell peppers, and zesty diced tomatoes.
ingredient_lines: 1 (10 ounce) can diced tomatoes with green chile peppers
instruction_lines: Heat oil in a large saucepan over medium heat. Add onion and bell peppers; cook and stir until softened, about 5 minutes.
Stir in chicken broth, black beans, kidney beans, pinto beans, and diced tomatoes. Cook until heated through, 10 to 15 minutes.
